subject: M029 RDP-safe choice-driven workbench, persistent actual-engine preview, consequence-aware decisions, recovery, deterministic promotion, and M030 readiness
acceptanceCriteria: The workbench is usable through editable text-stream input and mouse/touch without raw physical key events.
Text can be corrected before explicit submission, and invalid input records no decision.
Mouse/touch and text submission produce identical canonical actions.
The numbered workflow is usable without raw metadata editing.
One persistent preview uses actual engine audiovisual systems.
High-impact consequences require confirmation and presentation-only approval remains possible.
Preview failure and resume do not lose decisions or disable workbench input.
Promotion deterministically matches effective decisions with complete provenance.
M030 has sufficient approved inputs without consumer integration occurring in M029.
